spans.s:
1 The cocoa-nut tree.
--2
The blue jay.
--3 The Cātaka bird;
(the bird is also named as किकिन्,
किकिदिवि, किकीदिवि).

किक्किशः A kind of worm, (said
to be injurious to the hair, nails,
and teeth).

कीकट a. (टी f.)
1 Poor, indigent.
--2 Miserly.
--टाः (pl.) N. of a
country (Behar).
--टः A horse.
